# Security Policy

OrgAnchor is currently an alpha project. It has automated tests, package checks,
coverage gates, dependency auditing, and CodeQL scanning, but it has not yet
completed an independent security or cryptographic implementation review.

Do not rely on the alpha as the sole control for production-critical identity,
custody, legal, safety, or procurement decisions.

## Reporting A Vulnerability

For a non-sensitive implementation or documentation problem, use the
[technical review issue form](https://github.com/OrgAnchor/OrgAnchor/issues/new?template=technical-review.yml).

For a vulnerability that should not be public before remediation, email
`organchor.admin@proton.me`. Do not include private keys, active credentials,
customer-confidential evidence, or other secrets. Send the smallest safe
reproduction first and arrange a safer transfer path if additional material is
needed.

The project will acknowledge a credible report, preserve the report's scope,
and avoid describing a fix as a security certification.
